### Risks

- Initializer byte copying currently defaults new files to mode 0644, so a launcher requires an explicit owned executable-mode rule.
- Do not claim a selected module exists until its helper route is implemented; the plan proposes it.

### Acceptance criteria

- Create and first prepare-existing use current Template assets; selected earlier completed projects retain their base receipt edition and add only the named app module.
- Unchanged owned package updates, new executable launcher mode and private content provenance have exact source/destination receipts; customized/incomplete/conflicting packages are preserved and reported.
- Reruns preserve later custom text/configuration, same-operation recovery checks frozen inputs, and rollback restores only operation-owned package/configuration changes.
- The supported beneath-Projects destination boundary remains intact; root adoption is separate and no runtime, backend, Task or service is started.

### Planned verification

- Inspect the changed create/prepare/module/mode branches against existing receipt and preservation helpers; consolidate only uncovered changed-branch fixture checks into TASK-017 rather than rerunning the full initializer suite.
- Run .venv/bin/python tools/template_update.py check, review the complete selected update, apply through that owner and recheck current state. Keep source, generated Template and selected root-adoption receipts separate.
